description_en: Deletes active network objects from the container firewall
description_zh: 删除容器防火墙中生效的网络对象
name: DeleteInterceptionTarget

parameters.help_en:
The list of network object IDs to delete.
You can call the [ListInterceptionTargetPage](~~ListInterceptionTargetPage~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
待删除的网络对象ID列表。
您可以调用[ListInterceptionTargetPage](~~ListInterceptionTargetPage~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: target_ids

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Result.description_en:
Indicates whether the network objects were deleted. Valid values:
true: The network objects were deleted.
false: The network objects failed to be deleted
Result.description_zh:
删除网络对象是否成功。取值：
true：成功
false：失败
